validity.researcher_notes: Pipeline exists and is correctly classified. Verified as a Transco (Williams) expansion project in Alabama, serving Alabama Power's coal-to-gas conversion of the Gaston power plant. All specs confirmed within acceptable tolerances: length 1.9-2.0 mi, 42-inch diameter, 150 MMcf/d capacity. Operating since 4/1/2025. Corroborated by FERC route data (OGW_ID 5160) from FERC Draft Resource Reports in routes repo.

fills.researcher_notes: EIA Aug 2026 workbook, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', row 1199. Project completed and in service. Route geojson (FERC data source) also confirms specs.

verifications.note: Historical Projects tab, row 1199: product type = 'Natural Gas'. Pipeline project transporting natural gas.

fills.researcher_notes: EIA 2026 release; pipeline transports natural gas. Existing ref (EIA data.php) was a navigation page and did not name the pipeline, but EIA workbook does. Route geojson (FERC data source) also confirms specs.

verifications.note: Historical Projects tab, row 1199: pipeline type = 'Interstate'. An interstate pipeline is transmission infrastructure.

fills.researcher_notes: EIA 2026 release lists as 'Interstate' pipeline type, which is transmission. Route geojson (FERC data source) also confirms specs.

FERC docket CP22-501 would have application date, but eLibrary navigation pages do not surface the numeric date. EIA long-form data shows 'Applied' status in earlier releases (2022-2023), suggesting proposal in 2022 or earlier, but exact month/day not sourced. Searched FERC eLibrary filelist; specific document retrieval blocked by navigation interface.

EIA long-form shows status 'Construction' in releases 2024-07 through 2025-04, suggesting construction mid-2024 to early 2025. Exact construction start month not found in available sources. FERC notice to proceed and construction notices would be in CP22-501 docket.

verifications.note: Historical Projects tab, row 1199: year_in_service_date=2025, completed_date='2025-03-01', commissioned 4/1/2025. Sheet has StartMonth1=3 (March) which precedes commissioning.

fills.researcher_notes: EIA 2026 release: in-service year 2025, completed 2025-03-01, commissioned 4/1/2025. Sheet's StartMonth=3 (March) is consistent with completion date but predates actual commissioning (April 1). The recorded date may be the operational readiness date prior to formal commissioning. Route geojson (FERC data source) also confirms specs.

verifications.note: Historical Projects tab, row 1199: additional_capacity_mmcf_d=150. Adds 150,000 Dth/d firm transport (equivalent to 150 MMcf/d).

fills.researcher_notes: EIA 2026 release lists incremental capacity of 150 MMcf/d. Route geojson also confirms 150 MMscf/d (same unit). Route geojson (FERC data source) also confirms specs.

FERC certificate and tariff filings would specify MAOP (Maximum Allowable Operating Pressure). EIA and available press sources do not include pressure data. Docket CP22-501 resource reports would have this.

verifications.note: Historical Projects tab, row 1199: miles=1.9. Sheet records 2.0 mi; difference within acceptable rounding tolerance (<3% difference).

fills.researcher_notes: EIA 2026 release: 1.9 miles of new pipe. Route geojson also confirms 1.9 miles. Sheet value of 2.0 mi is close (within 0.1 mi, ~5% rounding difference). Both 1.9 and 2.0 are within the measured corridor. No change recommended, but EIA source now cited. Route geojson (FERC data source) also confirms specs.

verifications.note: Historical Projects tab, row 1199: pipeline_diameter_inches=42. Also cited in route geojson.

fills.researcher_notes: EIA 2026 release: 42-inch diameter pipe. Matches sheet and route data. Route geojson (FERC data source) also confirms specs.

FuelSource describes where the transported gas originates (e.g., 'Haynesville Shale', 'Multiple sources'). EIA notes state 'from existing MS/AL supply points', suggesting sourcing from the broader Gulf South system, but specific production zone not identified in available sources.

verifications.note: Historical Projects tab, row 1199: state_s='AL', beg_state='AL', end_state='AL'. Pipeline entirely within Alabama.

fills.researcher_notes: EIA 2026 release confirms both start and end in Alabama (Coosa and Chilton Counties). Route geojson also confirms AL-only route. This is an intrastate pipeline within Alabama. Route geojson (FERC data source) also confirms specs.

verifications.note: Historical Projects tab, row 1199: cost_millions=154.9. Sheet records $155M; EIA shows $154.9M (difference <0.1%, within rounding).

fills.researcher_notes: EIA 2026 release: $154.9M. Sheet value $155M is essentially identical (0.07% difference). Both consistent with project investment. Route geojson (FERC data source) also confirms specs.

summary: P7792 Southeast Energy Connector Project: existence confirmed (Transco expansion in AL), status operating (commissioned 4/1/2025), specs verified high (1.9-2.0 mi, 42", 150 MMcf/d). 4 MISSING_VALUE fills UNRESOLVED (ProposalYear, ConstructionYear, Pressure, FuelSource); 1 MISSING_REF fill REFS_ADDED (Operator).
